review: 511.3-1: decision said B was 'holding priority' in A's end of combat step, but A gets priority first; reworded so A passes and then B casts Condemn.

scenarios.title: An 'at end of combat' trigger fires as the end of combat step begins

setup.notes: Cinder Wall (3/3 defender): whenever it blocks, destroy it at end of combat. Both creatures have been under their controllers' control since before this turn.

decisions: A attacks B with Grizzly Bears.
B blocks Grizzly Bears with Cinder Wall (base variant); its block trigger resolves in the declare blockers step.
No other spells or abilities are used; both players pass through combat damage and into the end of combat step.

variants.label: wall_blocks
variants.expected: Combat damage is dealt first (Cinder Wall takes 2 damage and survives the damage step; Grizzly Bears takes 3 and dies). The delayed trigger fires as the end of combat step begins, and when it resolves Cinder Wall moves to B's graveyard before the postcombat main phase.

variants.label: no_block
variants.expected: Cinder Wall's block trigger never fires, so no 'end of combat' ability triggers: Cinder Wall stays on the battlefield, B's life is 18 and Grizzly Bears survives.

scenarios.title: An 'until end of combat' effect expires at the end of the combat phase, an 'until end of turn' effect does not

setup.notes: Jade Statue ({2}: becomes a 3/6 Golem artifact creature until end of combat; activate only during combat) has been under A's control since before this turn. Giant Growth is used only in the growth_persists variant. Observation points: A holds priority in the end of combat step, then in the postcombat main phase.

decisions: A activates Jade Statue, tapping both Mountains; the ability resolves.
A attacks B with Jade Statue; B declares no blockers.
No other spells or abilities are used; both players pass through combat damage, the end of combat step and into the postcombat main phase.

variants.label: statue_expires
variants.expected: Jade Statue deals 3 combat damage (B at 17). In the end of combat step Jade Statue is still a 3/6 Golem artifact creature. In the postcombat main phase the effect has ended: Jade Statue is a noncreature artifact. Grizzly Bears is 2/2 throughout.

variants.label: growth_persists
variants.delta: In the beginning of combat step A also casts Giant Growth (tapping Forest) targeting Grizzly Bears, and it resolves.
variants.expected: Jade Statue behaves as in the base variant (creature in the end of combat step, noncreature in the postcombat main phase), but Grizzly Bears is still 5/5 in both the end of combat step and the postcombat main phase, because Giant Growth lasts until end of turn.

scenarios.forge_notes: Jade Statue uses Duration$ UntilEndOfCombat; confirm Forge removes it when the end of combat phase ends and not at the start of the end of combat step.

scenarios.title: At the end of the end of combat step creatures are removed from combat

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears has been under A's control since before this turn. Condemn ({W} instant): put target attacking creature on the bottom of its owner's library; its controller gains life equal to its toughness.

decisions: A attacks B with Grizzly Bears; B declares no blockers.
Combat damage is dealt (B at 18); both players pass until the end of combat step.
In the end of combat step, A passes priority and B casts Condemn targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Plains (base variant).

variants.label: end_of_combat_step
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is still an attacking creature during the end of combat step, so casting Condemn is legal (has_legal_target true, can_play true). It resolves: Grizzly Bears goes to the bottom of A's library and A gains 2 life (22).

variants.label: postcombat_main
variants.delta: Both players pass in the end of combat step and B tries to cast Condemn in the postcombat main phase instead.
variants.expected: The end of combat step has ended, so Grizzly Bears has been removed from combat and is no longer attacking: Condemn has no legal target and casting it is not legal (can_play false). Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield and A's life stays 20.
